R0.geometry_note: The measured-layout artifact is absent from this checkout. Default marker centres and normals come from CAD; edge lengths are the two-capture means documented in box_umi_marker_rig_tcp_20260818.html. Load marker_layout/measured_v1 in the UI before a G0 decision.

cameras.note: The app ships a declared seven-camera fisheye rig so it runs without production files. It can establish geometry mechanisms and sensitivity, not production accuracy. A frozen production K/D/extrinsic snapshot is required for G2.

trajectory.note: Deterministic continuous SE(3) episodes cover the shared workspace. No estimated visual trajectory is used as truth. A frozen real task-distribution sample is required for G2.
